senses.gloss:
मुकन्दक मुकन्दक, अस्, m. probably an
error for सु-कन्दक, an onion.

मुकय मुकय, अस्, ई, m. f., see Pāṇ. IV.
1, 63.
मुकाबिला मुकाबिला = مقابلة
मुकारिणा मुकारिणा = مقارنة

मुकु मुकु, उस्, m. = मुक्ति, liberation; (an
artificial word, formed fr. rt. 2. मुच्, to explain मु-
कुन्-द, q. v., for which purpose others assume मु-
कुम्, ind.)

मुकुट मुकुट, अम्, n. a tiara, diadem,
crown (said to be crescent-shaped; the किरीट being
pointed, and the मौलि having three points); a
crest; a peak, point, head [cf. त्रि-म्˚]; N. of a
place; (अस्), m. a proper N. (contracted fr. राज-
मुकुट); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people or of a race;
(आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon
Skanda; (ई), f. snapping the fingers (= मुचुटी,
fr. rt. 2. मुच्).
—मुकुट-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
sacred bathing-place.
—मुकुटे-कार्षापण, अम्,
n. epithet of a tax or tribute raised for a royal
diadem (in the east of India).
—मुकुटेश्वर (˚ट-
ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king; (ई), f. a N. of Dā-
kṣāyaṇī in Mākoṭa (Mukuṭa).
—मुकुटेश्वर-
तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

मुकुट्ट मुकुट्ट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(also read सुकुट्ट.)
मुकुटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crowned, wearing a diadem.

मुकुण्टी मुकुण्टी, f. a kind of weapon;
(perhaps an error for सु-कुण्ठी.)

मुकुन्द मुकुन्-द, अस्, m. (according to an
artificial etymology, fr. मुकु, q. v., मुकुन्-द
being said to mean ‘giver of liberation’), N. of
Viṣṇu (sometimes transferred to Śiva); of a parti-
cular treasure; a kind of precious stone; quicksilver;
the resin of Boswellia Thurifera, gum olibanum; a
kind of drum or kettle-drum; N. of various learned
men (= गोविन्द, वाराहताजिक-मुकुन्द, मु-
कुन्द-पण्डित); N. of a mountain.
—मुकुन्द-
देव, अस्, m., N. of various princes of Orissa (=
वीर-म्˚).
—मुकुन्द-प्रिय, अस्, m., N. of a certain
teacher; of the father of the commentator Rāmā-
nanda.
—मुकुन्द-भट्ट, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मुकुन्द-माला, f. ‘Mukunda-garland,’ N. of a
prayer in twenty-two verses addressed to Mukunda
(Viṣṇu).
—मुकुन्द-मिश्र, अस्, m., N. of a
Brāhman.
—मुकुन्द-मुनि, इस्, or मुकुन्द-
राज, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मुकुन्द-राम, अस्,
[]
m. a proper N.
—मुकुन्द-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of
a scribe.

मुकुन्दक, अस्, m. a species of grain reckoned
among the Ku-dhānyas; an onion (= सु-कुन्दक,
सु-कन्दक; cf. मुकन्दक).

मुकुन्दु, उस्, m. = मुकुन्द, the resin of Bos-
wellia Thurifera; gum olibanum.
मुकुम् मुकुम्, ind. See मुकु, col. 1.

मुकुर मुकुर, अस्, m. a mirror (= मकुर;
cf. कर्ण-मुकुर, मति-म्˚); the stick or handle
of a potter's wheel; Mimusops Elengi; Jasminum
Zambac (= कुल-वृक्ष); a bud (= मुकुल
below).

मुकुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) = मुकुलित
below; see Gaṇa Tārakādi to Pāṇ. V. 2, 31.

मुकुल मुकुल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps con-
nected with rt. 2. मुच्), a bud, opening bud or
calyx of a flower, (in these senses also written म-
कुल, q. v.); anything shaped like a bud, (दशन-
म्˚, a bud-like tooth); a bud-like junction or bring-
ing together of the fingers of the hand, (in this sense
only अस्, m.); the body; the soul or spirit; N. of
a king; of another person; (अम्), n. a kind of
metre, four times ¯ ¯ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯.
—मुकुलाग्र (˚ल-
अग्˚), अम्, n. a particular surgical instrument with
a bud-like point.
—मुकुली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति,
-कर्तुम्, to close (the hands) in the form of a bud.
—मुकुली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, shut (as a bud).
—मुकुली-भाव, अस्, m. closing, being closed (as
a flower).

मुकुलय, Nom. P. मुकुलयति, &c., to close,
cause to close (the eyes, &c.).

मुकुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, budded, having buds, blos-
soming, full of blossoms; closed like a bud, half
closed; half shut (as the eye), blinking, winking;
closed, shut.
—मुकुलिताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
having half closed eyes.
मुकुलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, budding, budded, having buds.

मुकुष्ठ मुकुष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, = मन्थर;
(अस्), m. a species of bean; [cf. मकुष्ठ.]
मुकुष्ठक, अस्, m. a species of bean.

मुकूलक मुकूलक, अस्, m. = मकूलक, a
species of plant (commonly Danti).

मुक्त मुक्त, मुक्ति, &c. See p. 782, col. 3,
and p. 783, col. 2.

मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosened, loosed, let loose,
set free, relaxed, (मुक्तैर् अवयवैः, with loos-
ened or relaxed limbs); unloosed, opened, open [cf.
मुक्त-हस्त]; redeemed, released, extricated, libe-
rated, emancipated (from sin or from worldly exist-
ence), finally happy, saved; abandoned, relinquished,
quitted, left, put off, laid aside; given up; bestowed,
granted, given; discharged, emitted, shed, thrown,
cast, hurled, darted, shot, sent, sent forth, poured
forth, (वर्णोदकैः काञ्चन-शृङ्ग-मुक्तैः,
with coloured waters poured forth from golden vials);
ejected, spit out; fallen; deprived; (अस्), m., N. of
one of the seven sages under Manu Bhautya; N.
of a cook in Rāja-taraṅgiṇī VII. 1635, &c.; (आ), f.,
scil. दिश्, the quarter just quitted by the sun (e. g. if
the sun be in the south, the south is said to be
प्राप्तार्का, and the south-east मुक्ता); a pearl (as
loosened or set free from the pearl-oyster shell); a
courtezan, harlot; a species of plant, = रास्ना; (अम्),
n. the spirit released from corporeal existence.
—मुक्त-कच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, letting the hem of
the lower garment hang down or leaving it loose
and untucked; (अस्), m. a Buddhist.
—मुक्त-कञ्-
चुक, अस्, m. a snake that has cast its slough.
—मुक्त-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, having a loos-
ened or free throat, raising a cry, shrill; (अम्), ind.
aloud.
—मुक्त-कर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, open-handed,
liberal, bountiful.
—मुक्त-केश, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्,
‘loose-haired,’ having flowing hair, having the hair
dishevelled or hanging down.
—मुक्त-चक्षुस्,
उस्, उस्, उस्, having the eyes opened; (उस्), m. ‘cast-
ing glances,’ a lion.
—मुक्त-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one
whose soul is liberated (from existence), emancipated.
—मुक्त-ता, f. or मुक्त-त्व, अम्, n. emancipation,
liberation, the being liberated from existence.
—मु-
क्त-ध्वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, giving out thunder (as a
cloud).
—मुक्त-निद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from sleep,
awakened.
—मुक्त-निर्मोक, अस्, आ, अम्, = मुक्त-
कञ्चुक, q. v.
—मुक्त-फूत्कार, अस्, आ, अम्,
uttering a scream, screaming.
—मुक्त-फूत्कृति,
इस्, f. uttering a shriek, shrieking; hissing.
—मुक्त-
बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, released from bonds, freed
from fetters.
—मुक्त-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one whose
[]
soul is liberated, emancipated.
—मुक्त-मण्डूक-
कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having frogs croaking loudly
(lit. with loosened throats).
—मुक्त-मूर्धज,
अस्, आ, अम्, = मुक्त-केश, q. v.
—मुक्त-रोधो-
नितम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, quitting the hip-like bank.
—मुक्त-रोष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid
aside or relinquished anger.
—मुक्त-लज्ज, अस्, आ,
अम्, casting away shame.
—मुक्त-वसन, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has put off his clothes, going about
naked; (अस्), m. an epithet of a Jaina ascetic.
—मुक्त-व्यापार, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has re-
signed an office or occupation.
—मुक्त-संशय,
अस्, आ, अम्, free from doubt, certain.
—मुक्त-सङ्ग,
अस्, आ, अम्, free from worldly or selfish attachment,
disinterested.
—मुक्त-स्वामिन्, ई, m. ‘lord of eman-
cipation,’ N. of a statue erected by a king (Rāja-
taraṅgiṇī IV. 188).
—मुक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
open-handed, liberal, easily parting with possessions,
giving away, profuse; loosed, let go.
—मुक्ता-कण,
अस्, m. (for मुक्ता-कर्ण), a proper N.
—मुक्ता-
कलाप, अस्, m. an ornament made of strings of
pearls, pearl necklace.
—मुक्ताकार (˚ता-आक्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having the look or appearance of a pearl.
—मुक्ताकार-ता, f. the form of a pearl, likeness
to a pearl.
—मुक्ता-केशव, अस्, m., N. of a statue
of Kṛṣṇa.
—मुक्तागार (˚ता-अग्˚) or -आग्˚), अम्, n.
‘pearl-abode,’ the pearl-oyster.
—मुक्ता-गुण, अस्,
m. a string of pearls; the excellence of a pearl, lustre
or water of a pearl.
—मुक्ता-जाल, अम्, n. an orna-
ment of pearls, a string or multitude of pearls, a
pearly zone; [cf. मुक्ता-फल-जाल.]
—मुक्ता-
जाल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of pearls.
—मुक्तात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, m. the emancipated
soul, the soul released from matter; (आ, आ, अ), one
whose soul is liberated, emancipated.
—मुक्ता-दा-
मन्, आ, m. a string of pearls.
—मुक्ता-पटल,
अम्, n. a mass of pearls.
—मुक्तापीड (˚त-आप्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a king; of a poet.
—मुक्ता-पुर,
अम्, n., N. of a mythical city in the Himālaya moun-
tains.
—मुक्ता-पुष्प, अस्, m. Jasminum Multi-
florum or Pubescens.
—मुक्ता-प्रसू, ऊस्, f. ‘pearl-
bearing,’ mother of pearl, the pearl-oyster; [cf.
मुक्ता-मातृ, मौक्तिक-प्रसवा.]
—मुक्ता-प्रा-
लम्ब, अस्, m. a string of pearls, pearl ornament,
(also read मुक्ता-प्रलम्ब.)
—मुक्ता-फल, अम्,
n. a pearl; a species of flower; the fruit of the Lavalī
plant, the custard apple; camphor; title of a work
by Vopa-deva; N. of a king of the Śavaras.
—मु-
क्ताफल-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a king of the Vidyā-
dharas.
—मुक्ताफल-जाल, अम्, n. = मुक्ता-जाल.
—मुक्ताफल-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—मुक्ताफल-परीक्षा, f., N. of the eighty-first
Adhyāya in the Varāha-brāhmaṇa-saṃhitā.
—मुक्ता-
फल-लता, f. a string of pearls; [cf. मुक्ता-लता.]
—मुक्ता-मणि, इस्, m. ‘pearl-gem,’ a pearl; [cf.
मुक्ता-रत्न.]
—मुक्ता-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or
consisting of pearls, pearly.
—मुक्ता-मातृ, ता, f.
mother of pearl, a pearl-oyster; [cf. मुक्ता-प्रसू.]
—मुक्तामुक्त (˚त-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, loosed and
not loosed (applied especially to weapons which may
be wielded or hurled, as clubs, javelins, &c.).
—मु-
क्ताम्बर (˚त-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has put
off his clothes, naked; (अस्), m. an epithet of a Jaina
ascetic; [cf. मुक्त-वसन.]
—मुक्ता-रत्न, अम्,
n. ‘pearl-gem,’ a pearl; [cf. मौक्तिक-रत्न.]
—मुक्ता-लता, f. a string of pearls, pearl necklace;
N. of a woman.
—मुक्तावली (˚ता-आव्˚), f. a pearl
necklace; N. of various works; of a dictionary; of
a commentary on the Megha-dūta; of the wife of
Candra-ketu.
—मुक्तावली-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N.
of a commentary by Dinakara-bhaṭṭa on the Nyāya-
siddhānta-muktāvalī; of a commentary by Maṇi-
rāma.
—मुक्ता-शुक्ति, इस्, f. a pearl-oyster (= मौ-
क्तिक-शुक्ति).
—मुक्तासन (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
leaving a seat, rising from a seat; (अम्), n. the
mode in which the emancipated are said to sit, a
particular posture of ascetics (= सिद्धासन, q. v.).
—मुक्ता-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Vidyā-
dharas.
—मुक्ता-स्थूल, अस्, आ, अम्, big as a pearl.
—मुक्ता-स्फोट, अस्, आ, m. f. a pearl-oyster.
—मु-
क्ता-स्रज्, क्, f. a chaplet of pearls.
—मुक्ता-हार,
[]
अस्, m. a string of pearls, pearl necklace.
—मुक्ते-
श्वर (˚त-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Liṅga.
मुक्षीजा मुक्षीजा, f. a net, snare.

मुक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, detached, separate, inde-
pendent; (अम्), n. a missile, any missile weapon;
a separate or detached Śloka the meaning of which
is complete in itself; simple prose (freed from all
compound words); a kind of metre.

मुक्ति, इस्, f. loosing, release, deliverance, liberation,
setting free, becoming free, freedom, emancipation
(e. g. दासत्व-मुक्ति, release from servitude; cf.
शाप-म्˚); final liberation or emancipation, final
beatitude, the delivery of the soul from the body
and exemption from further transmigration, the re-
absorption of the Jīvātman into the Paramātman or
Supreme Soul of the universe; unloosing, opening;
abandonment, putting off, giving up, leaving off;
discharging (rain, a missile, &c.); throwing, casting,
flinging, hurling, shooting, sending; discharge (of a
debt, cf. ऋन-म्˚); N. of a divine being, the wife
of Satya.
—मुक्ति-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. a place where
final emancipation is attainable; N. of a sacred place.
—मुक्ति-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. a book of precepts for
the attainment of final emancipation.
—मुक्ति-चिन्-
तामणि-माहात्म्य, अस्, m., N. of a work.
—मुक्ति-
पति, इस्, m. lord of bliss or beatitude.
—मुक्ति-पुर,
अम्, n., N. of a Dvīpa.
—मुक्ति-मण्डप, अस्, m.,
N. of a temple.
—मुक्ति-मती, f., N. of a river,
(also read भुक्ति-मती and शुक्ति-मती.)
—मुक्ति-
मार्ग, अस्, m. the way of liberation, path to final
emancipation.
—मुक्ति-मुक्त, अस्, m. incense, frank-
incense.
—मुक्ति-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having freedom,
freed from (with abl.).
—मुक्ति-वाद, अस्, m., N. of
a work.
—मुक्ति-विचार, अस्, m., N. of a philoso-
phical work.
—मुक्ति-सेन, अस्, m. a proper N.
मुक्तिका, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.

मुक्त्वा, ind. having loosed or freed or let go, (मु-
क्त्वा हासम्, having broken out into loud laughter);
having left or abandoned, having resigned; having
put on one side, having excepted, excepting, except,
(युद्धम् मुक्त्वा नान्यद् अस्ति मे, except a
battle there is nothing else for me); having discharged
or shed, having thrown or flung.

मूक, अस्, आ, अम्, dumb, silent, speechless, mute
[cf. एड-म्˚, कल्ल-म्˚]; wretched, poor; (अस्), m.
a mute; a poor man; N. of a Dānava; of a Nāga;
[cf. Lat. mutus.]
—मूक-ता, f. or मूक-त्व, अम्,
n. dumbness, muteness, silence.
—मूक-भाव, अस्,
m. the state of being dumb, dumbness.
—मूकाण्-
[]
डज (˚क-अण्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having the birds silent
(said of a forest).
—मूकाम्बिका (˚क-अम्˚), f. (per-
haps) a form of Durgā; मूकाम्बिकायाः सदनम्,
N. of a place.
—मूकी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्-
तुम्, to make dumb, render speechless, put to
silence.
मूकिमन्, आ, m. dumbness, muteness, silence.
मूकलराय मूकलराय, अस्, m., N. of a king.
